author: Swagr345
quote: How do you know it’s one of the best games of the decade? When you spend hours playing, yet it feels like only minutes have passed. The realism, the atmosphere, the driving, the combat, and the way the world around you reacts—all of it draws you completely into that universe. I haven’t played a game this powerful since *Red Dead Redemption 2* and *Elden Ring*; it is truly one of the greatest games in history.
